business_problem: Insurance operations at DXC's scale depend on judgment across large volumes of paper and digital submissions, claims, and regulatory rules. Manual document handling and slow rule changes created backlogs, errors, and high effort for claims and underwriting experts.
solution_summary: DXC runs Anthropic's Claude within Assure, its API-driven insurance orchestration platform, to support document intelligence, underwriting, claims, and compliance. Claude classifies incoming documents, extracts policy, party, amount, and date details, and flags exceptions for people. Workflow orchestration routes decisions to the appropriate staff, while purpose-built Smart Apps handle focused tasks such as first notice of loss and workers' compensation calculations. For regulated decisions, actions are logged, traceable, and replayable; agents operate within authority levels and humans review material decisions. Assure routes simpler work to lighter model tiers and longer claims files to frontier models. DXC employees also use Claude Code to build these capabilities. The deployment has reduced document backlogs and accelerated regulatory-rule updates.
